# Sheriyakam — Complete Service, Technical & Entity Knowledge Dossier

## 1. Entity & Company Information
- **Brand Name**: Sheriyakam (ശരിയാക്കാം)
- **Tagline**: Verified Doorstep Electricians in Thalassery & Mahe
- **Primary Domain**: https://sheriyakam.vercel.app
- **Local Dispatch Hub**: Thalassery, Kannur District, Kerala 670101, India
- **Customer Helpline & WhatsApp**: +91 94471 28901
- **Support Email**: support@sheriyakam.in
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 Priority Emergency Triage, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM General Doorstep Service

## 2. Mission & Core Operations
Sheriyakam is a specialized local electrical repair network operating in the Thalassery–Mahe corridor. The platform connects verified, KSELB-licensed master wiremen directly with homeowners and commercial property owners. Every visit includes upfront quote approval prior to work, genuine ISI-standard materials at MRP/hardware bill actuals, and a 30-day direct workmanship warranty.

## 3. Standard Tariffs & Service Offerings (Starting at ₹499)

### 3.1 Fault Inspection & Multimeter Diagnosis
- **Base Rate**: ₹499 (Adjusted/waived against final bill if work proceeds on-site)
- **Scope**: Multimeter line tracing, voltage fluctuation check, neutral link continuity, ground leakage detection.

### 3.2 Switchboard, Socket & Plug Repair
- **Base Rate**: ₹499 (Plus ISI spares at actual MRP)
- **Scope**: Burnt switch replacement, melted 16A AC/refrigerator power plugs, loose socket rewiring, and modular gang box fixes.

### 3.3 Ceiling & Exhaust Fan Repair / Installation
- **Base Rate**: ₹549
- **Scope**: EPCOS/heavy-duty capacitor replacement, electronic step regulator wiring, wobbling fan alignment, and new ceiling/exhaust fan mounting.

### 3.4 MCB, RCCB & Distribution Board (DB) Triage
- **Base Rate**: ₹649
- **Scope**: Main breaker tripping diagnosis, RCCB earth leakage isolation, burnt busbar overhaul, and short-circuit line clearance.

### 3.5 Inverter & Battery Wiring Setup
- **Base Rate**: ₹749
- **Scope**: Dual-battery DC terminal cabling, changeover switch mounting, bypass switch installation, and backup circuit segregation.

### 3.6 House Wiring, Additional Points & Safety Earthing
- **Base Rate**: ₹899 (Custom quote after detailed premise inspection)
- **Scope**: FRLS copper wire pulling through conduits, earth pit pipe/plate installation, shock protection, and additional point additions.

### 3.7 Emergency Night Breakdown Callout
- **Base Rate**: ₹999
- **Scope**: Immediate 45–90 min arrival after 7:00 PM for total blackouts, sparking switchboards, burning smells, and safety emergencies.

## 4. Verification & Workmanship Standards
- **Licensing**: 100% of technicians hold Kerala State Electricity Licensing Board (KSELB) wireman or supervisor permits.
- **Direct Phone Confirmation**: Master electricians place a direct voice call to the homeowner to confirm symptoms before dispatch.
- **Pay After Demonstration**: Payment is collected only after the repair is completed and tested. Accepts all UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) and cash.
- **Warranty**: 30-day rework warranty on all labor and service points repaired.

## 5. Active Service Coverage
- **Active Local Dispatch Zone**: Thalassery, Mahe, Dharmadam, Kadirur, Chokli, New Mahe, and Azhiyur.
